culture.title: What is Moxibustion?
culture.content: Moxibustion is a key component of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). It involves burning moxa (dried mugwort) near specific acupoints to warm meridians, dispel cold, and invigorate the body's vital energy (Qi). Recorded as early as the Huangdi Neijing, moxibustion has been proven by modern research to improve circulation, boost immunity, and relieve chronic pain. Our clinic upholds classical techniques and provides personalized treatment plans for every guest.
